Guidance (from Agile Delivery Playbook)
- Feature is the leadership unit of progress (% complete appears on the dashboard).
- Every Feature must declare an Artifact Level: Proposal for Work (default), Statement of Work, or Lightweight.
- Detailed scope, approach, risks, capacity, and full Done-When criteria live in the linked Proposal for Work or SOW - not in this Feature record.
- Anyone may capture a Feature; it starts as New / Not Reviewed and is triaged within one Intake cycle.
- -Feature done when-- bullets on this record are mandatory and are what leadership sees.
